## Infosys Pricing Updates

Infosys contracts typically use time-and-materials, fixed bid, managed service, or outcome-based structures depending on scope and maturity.

## Key Price Changes
- Managed services: Multi-year commitments can unlock stronger discounts
- Transformation programs: Fixed-bid phases reduce ambiguity when requirements are stable
- AI services: Pricing should reflect pilot scope, data complexity, and production support needs

## Business Impact
- Offshore leverage can reduce costs but requires strong governance
- Automation commitments can improve year-over-year productivity
- Scope creep remains the main commercial risk in transformation programs

## What This Means
- Benchmark rate cards against TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, and HCLTech
- Require productivity improvements and automation savings in the contract
- Tie AI pilot fees to measurable business outcomes and reusable assets
